div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 · Re-shadow
the distilled student mirrors the teacher over the same distribution

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5 · Fine-tune the router
an escalation classifier learns what the student still cannot handle

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6 · Promote
the student serves the domain; the teacher handles only the escalated tail

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1 · Shadow
teacher serves the client; the student mirrors and its output is discarded

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 · Judge
score the student against the teacher; one verdict per shadow arm

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 · Distill
SFT / LoRA on teacher outputs, for exactly the cases the student failed
